overview.en: The Rannoch Looper is a geometrid moth recorded here under the catalogue name Macaria brunneata; a 2024 molecular revision transferred it to Speranza.
overview.fr: Le Rannoch Looper est un papillon de nuit géométridé répertorié ici sous le nom Macaria brunneata ; une révision moléculaire de 2024 l’a transféré dans le genre Speranza.

identification.en: In Britain, adults are day-flying and often rest with their wings held closed like a butterfly.
identification.fr: En Grande-Bretagne, les adultes volent le jour et se reposent souvent les ailes fermées, à la manière d’un papillon diurne.

habitat.en: In Britain it is associated with mature woodland in central Scotland, although occasional migrants are recorded farther south.
habitat.fr: En Grande-Bretagne, il est associé aux boisements matures du centre de l’Écosse, même si des migrateurs occasionnels sont observés plus au sud.

diet.en: The caterpillars feed on bilberry, Vaccinium myrtillus.
diet.fr: Les chenilles se nourrissent de myrtille, Vaccinium myrtillus.

behavior.en: Adults appear in June and July in Britain and fly by day.
behavior.fr: En Grande-Bretagne, les adultes apparaissent en juin et juillet et volent de jour.

reproduction.en: The available accounts identify bilberry as the larval food plant but do not establish clutch size or brood number.
reproduction.fr: Les fiches disponibles indiquent la myrtille comme plante nourricière des chenilles, mais ne précisent ni la taille des pontes ni le nombre de générations.

ecology.en: Older checklists grouped it with Epelis carbonaria under Macaria, but recent molecular taxonomy places them in separate genera.
ecology.fr: Les anciennes listes regroupaient l’espèce avec Epelis carbonaria dans Macaria, mais la taxonomie moléculaire récente les place dans des genres distincts.

conservation.en: Butterfly Conservation assigns the Rannoch Looper medium threat priority in its Scotland strategy; this is a regional planning priority, not a global Red List category.
conservation.fr: Butterfly Conservation attribue au Rannoch Looper une priorité moyenne dans sa stratégie écossaise ; il s’agit d’une priorité régionale de planification, et non d’une catégorie mondiale de Liste rouge.

facts: Adults fly by day in June–July in Britain, often resting with wings closed; British populations are associated with mature central Scottish woodland and larvae feed on bilberry.

uncertainties: The project’s illustrated-species inventory still uses Macaria brunneata, while recent molecular taxonomy uses Speranza brunneata; the inventory label is retained for taxon matching.
British distribution and flight-season details are regional and should not be generalized to the full Holarctic range.
No current species-specific global conservation assessment or full reproductive account was located.
review_note: Taxonomic transfer checked against the 2024 molecular paper and 2025 Scottish strategy; compared with Epelis carbonaria without treating the former genus as current close kinship.
